description: Designated subject (rear passenger) gives a 2020 river crossing; the form records 2022; the driver's account differs

anchors: waded across the Rio Grande near Roma, Texas, in March 2020

labelNotes: The rear passenger is expressly designated as the subject of this record and states March 2020; the form records 03/2022. The driver's 2022 crossing matches the form's year but is another person's entry and must not be used to explain the conflict away.
